records.name: Hernand Castle
records.summary: The walled capital of Hernand: main-quest hub, vendors and the seat of the region's noble politics.
records.body: The city sits west of the Sena's tributaries in the middle of Hernand. [[vendor:rhett-hernand]] sells the starter Canta Plate armour here. The location is the walled city centre read off the map at zoom 5; the painted map label sits about 120 px east of it.

sources.title: The Hidden Gaming Lair: Crimson Desert map (fast-travel point)
Fextralife: Factions
sources.note: House seats and the city as Hernand's capital

records.name: Demeniss Castle
records.summary: House Caliburn's stronghold and the political heart of Demeniss.
records.body: Demeniss Castle is Pywel's political capital and the stronghold of House Thorel, now vacant in practice while King Edward Thorel lies in a coma with no named heir. Noble houses contest that gap, and the main story returns here for Blood Coronation, Counterattack and The Abyss. The rest point sits on the castle itself.

sources.title: The Hidden Gaming Lair: Crimson Desert map (fast-travel point)

records.name: Steel Mountains
records.summary: Mountain range in southern Hernand; the legendary horse Rokade grazes by a lake here near the Spire of Insight.
records.body: The Steel Mountains are a southern Hernand range; this landmark sits among the village cluster around Florindale and Vellua. A lake below the peaks is where the legendary horse Rokade is found, near the Spire of Insight. Two location indexes, the Fextralife Locations page and Game8's all-region list, instead file the mountains and the Bay of Steel under Demeniss.

sources.title: The Hidden Gaming Lair: Crimson Desert map (fast-travel point)

records.summary: The Greymane camp hit in the opening raid; the companion research places it in Pailune, the main-story research in Hernand.

records.summary: The city tavern that opens after the prologue and hosts the first errands of Chapter 1.

records.summary: A Hernand watchtower held by bandits at the start of Chapter 2, with a helm left on site.

records.name: Springtide Mill
records.summary: A mill on the river where Chapter 2 sends Kliff to clear out enemies.

records.name: Goldleaf Merchant Guild
records.summary: The Goldleaf merchants' guild and camp, investigated near the end of Chapter 2.

records.name: Serkis Estate

records.name: Howling Hill

records.name: Reedfield Graves

records.name: House of Healing
records.summary: The healing house in Hernand that Familiar Curses sends Kliff into.

records.summary: The workshop where an explosion opens Chapter 4 and the kilns are put back to work.

records.name: Scholastone Institute

records.name: Spire of the Stars

records.name: Church
records.summary: The church where Chapter 5 sends Kliff for a relic and the Pillar of Radiance.

records.name: Spire of Soaring
records.summary: The spire woken in Toward the Nest before the last fight with Crowcaller.

records.name: Calphade Gate
records.summary: The gate into Calphadean ground where Marshal Middler briefs the counterattack.

records.name: Siege Armory
records.summary: A Calphadean armory where a Banner Pike must be raised during Cradle of Defense.

records.name: Gunpowder Mill
records.summary: A mill on the Calphadean line that takes a Banner Pike during Cradle of Defense.

records.name: Thalwynd
records.summary: A Calphadean site that takes the third Banner Pike during Cradle of Defense.

records.name: Southern Guard Post
records.summary: A southern post on the Calphadean line where a soldier waits during The Touch of Deliverance.

records.name: Deepfog Basin
records.summary: The basin that hides the Black Bears' base during Turning Tides.

records.name: Calphade Castle
records.summary: The Calphadean castle taken at the close of Chapter 6, where Cassius Morten is fought.
records.body: Calphade Castle is House Lanford's seat in the [[region:calphadean-territory]], the Duchy of Hernand's northern march against Pailune. Chapter 6 ends here with the fight against Cassius Morten. The rest point on the map is labelled Calphade Castle Hearth; the castle watches that same frontier.

records.name: Beighen
records.summary: The Pailune settlement Ashes of Treachery sends the company to after a shrine is checked.
records.body: Beighen is Pailune's southern village, held by the Beighen Tribe and by the Blue Fangs resistance also called the Beighen Militia. Chapter 7 sends the company here during Ashes of Treachery. It sits on the milder edge of the snow country, looking toward the occupied highlands.

sources.title: The Hidden Gaming Lair: Crimson Desert map (fast-travel point)

records.name: Pailune
records.summary: The northern city taken back in Homecoming and used as the first hub of Blood Coronation.
records.body: Pailune is the northern city's hub and the seat of the Pailune Militia; faction writeups treat it as the region's capital. Chapter 7 (Homecoming) takes the city back, and Chapter 8 uses it as an early hub. The fast-travel bell stays locked behind a conflict area until Chapter 7.

sources.title: The Hidden Gaming Lair: Crimson Desert map (fast-travel point)

records.summary: The camp Broken Claws sends the company to free during the Decisive Battle stretch.

records.name: Silverwolf Mountain
records.summary: The mountain where Myurdin is found and fought at the close of the Decisive Battle stretch.

records.name: Azerian Manor
records.summary: The Azerian house slipped into during Blazing Fire, then left again in a hurry.

records.name: Sungrove Manor

records.name: Windmere Manor
records.summary: Count Byron's house, entered during Bloodied Invitation for the killing that follows.

records.name: Demeniss Court
records.summary: The court where the Traitor stretch starts the search for Beatrice Azerian.

records.name: Cloister of Enlightenment
records.summary: The desert cloister where Golden Statues are purified and the Chapter 9 trials keep returning.

records.name: Urdavah
records.summary: A Crimson Desert settlement where the Shattered Ties tablet is read and a dragon is freed.

records.name: Spire of the Sun
records.summary: The desert spire crossed during Thinning Blade and Unwavering Steps.

records.name: Morning Mist Peaks
records.summary: The Demeniss peaks where the Pensive Statues of Chapter 9 are repaired.

records.name: Jijeong Temple
records.summary: The temple in uproar while its statues are put back together during Chapter 9.

records.name: Gorthak Ironworks
records.summary: The Demeniss works occupied by machines in Chapter 10, and Valgash's shop floor.

records.name: Delesyia Castle
records.summary: The steel-city castle that opens Chapter 11 once Delesyia is reached.

records.name: Valvegard Garrison
records.summary: A Delesyia garrison that holds one of the three fortress keys in Chapter 11.

records.name: Marni's Laboratorium
records.summary: Marni's workshop in Delesyia, one of the three sites that yield a fortress key.

records.name: Aeronautical Research Base
records.summary: A Delesyia air-research site that holds the third fortress key.

records.name: Nest of Valor
records.summary: The nest Whispers in the Wind sends Kliff to after Golden Star falls.

records.name: Cloud Castle Orbian
records.summary: The flying fortress whose cores must be broken before H.A.L.L. is fought.

records.name: Fort Musket's Outpost
records.summary: The Demeniss outpost where Chapter 12's last campaign is reported in.

records.name: Delesyia Castle Gate
records.summary: The castle gate where a Visione device is used during the epilogue to reach Marni.

records.name: Arboria
records.summary: A Hernand village in Arboria Forest, listed beside a castle and craftshop of the same name.
records.body: Arboria is a village in [[region:arboria-forest]]. Location lists also name Arboria Castle and Arboria Craftshop at the same place. The rest point sits on the village in that forest tract.

sources.title: The Hidden Gaming Lair: Crimson Desert map (fast-travel point)

records.name: Arcosa
records.summary: The Crimson Desert's most prosperous village, held by the Arcosa Tribe and watched from its towers.
records.body: Arcosa is the Arcosa Tribe's main village in the Crimson Desert. Sources call it the busiest settlement in the region and note watchtowers raised against raid after raid. The rest point sits on the village itself.

sources.title: The Hidden Gaming Lair: Crimson Desert map (fast-travel point)

records.name: Arcosa Trade Depot
records.summary: A trade depot beside Arcosa; no guide yet names the site, so the region is taken from the village next to it.
records.body: Arcosa Trade Depot is a fast-travel stop next to [[place:arcosa]]. No guide names the depot yet; the region is inferred from that neighbouring village. Treat it as a satellite yard rather than a settlement of its own.

sources.title: The Hidden Gaming Lair: Crimson Desert map (fast-travel point)

records.name: Batihar
records.summary: A Crimson Desert village seized by The Helms and used as a captured base.
records.body: Batihar is a desert village taken by force by The Helms, who keep it as a captured base. A figure named Rusten is recorded as the weapon they used to take it. It sits in the northern village cluster of the Crimson Desert.

records.summary: A Crimson Desert town of labyrinth-like towers, home to the Disciples of Master Du.
records.body: Burhum is a desert town known for a labyrinth-like tower style. The Disciples of Master Du hold it; [[character:master-du]] is named as a resident and later as a Chapter 9 trial master. It sits in the same desert village belt as Caledora and Duzhar.

records.summary: A Tashkalp village near Tommaso, known for brightly dyed fabrics.
records.body: Caledora is a village in [[region:tashkalp]], near Tommaso. It is known for vibrant dyed fabrics. One of the region's fog-clearing bells is also placed in that same stretch.

records.name: Castlewood Ruins
records.summary: Ruined stone in southern Hernand; no guide names the site, so the region is inferred from nearby villages.
records.body: Castlewood Ruins is a fast-travel ruin in southern Hernand, near Florindale and Pororin. No guide names the place yet; the region is inferred from those neighbouring villages. What still stands is stone, not a living settlement.

records.name: Dewhaven Castle
records.summary: Delesyia castle that houses the Ironwheel workshop, arguing machines should assist people rather than replace them.
records.body: Dewhaven Castle is a Delesyia stronghold and the home of the Ironwheel of Dewhaven, a workshop faction. The Ironwheel holds that machines should assist people, a stance set against [[character:marni]]. Players find the workshop on the castle grounds.

sources.title: The Hidden Gaming Lair: Crimson Desert map (fast-travel point)

records.summary: A small Crimson Desert village near Fort Manub, left in ruins after kidnappings.
records.body: Duzhar is a small village near Fort Manub in the Crimson Desert. The Twilight Messengers set up a base here and began kidnapping residents, and the place is now described as ruins. The map still treats the rest point as a village.

records.summary: A village beside Demeniss Castle; no guide names it, so the region is inferred from that neighbour.
records.body: Easelbury is a fast-travel village close to [[place:demeniss-castle]]. No guide names the place yet; the region is inferred from that castle. Treat it as a Demeniss settlement on the castle's doorstep.

records.name: Florindale
records.summary: A southern Hernand village named on the location indexes, with no further published detail.
records.body: Florindale is a village in southern Hernand, listed on the Fextralife Locations page. No source read here names a ruling house or services. It sits in the same southern cluster as Pororin, Senia and Vellua.

sources.title: The Hidden Gaming Lair: Crimson Desert map (fast-travel point)

records.name: Fort Musket
records.summary: A Demeniss fort built as a forward base for the push into the Crimson Desert.
records.body: Fort Musket is a Demeniss fort north of the capital and south of the Valley of the Moon. It was raised as a forward base for Demeniss's expansion into the Crimson Desert. The rest point is tagged as a fort on this map.

records.summary: The Helms' desert village, used as the hub of their engineering work.
records.body: Helmara is a Crimson Desert village held by The Helms as their base of operations. Sources call it the hub of their engineering work, even while the faction is known as bandits. It sits in the northern desert village cluster with Batihar and Nahab.

records.summary: A Demeniss sanctum listed on both location indexes, sharing a name with Hexe Marie.
records.body: Hexe Sanctuary is a Demeniss sanctum on the Fextralife and Game8 location indexes. The name matches [[character:hexe-marie]], a Chapter 9 boss, but no source read here states that the fight is here. Players find a rest point at the sanctum itself.

records.summary: A Hernand village in vine-choked wilds, where House Serkis tenants work the vines.
records.body: Ivynook is a Hernand village in vine-choked country. House Serkis holds it, and the residents cultivate and process vines for a living. A dedicated Fextralife page names the settlement.

records.name: Kweiden
records.summary: A Pailune mountain town, Kliff's home and the staging point for the high country.
records.body: Kweiden is a rugged mountain town in Pailune, built in timber-longhouse style and used as the main staging point for the higher, more dangerous country. Local clans, Greymane members and mercenaries share it; [[character:kliff]] is said to hail from here, and the town has vendors, a blacksmith and a notice board. One territory database uses the same name for Pailune's tribal lands as a whole; this record treats Kweiden as a settlement, not a region.

records.summary: A Tashkalp village on the eastern edge, held by the Muiquun Outlaws beside a small stream.
records.body: Muiquun sits on the eastern edge of [[region:tashkalp]], scorched by heat and sandstorms and kept alive by a small nearby stream. The Muiquun Outlaws hold the village. Tashkalp also holds Caledora and one of the region's fog-clearing bells.

records.summary: A small Crimson Desert village near Fort Manub, kept alive by a well and held by The Faceless.
records.body: Nahab is a small village near Fort Manub in the Crimson Desert. A well — one of the desert's most valuable resources — keeps it alive despite a Twilight Messengers base nearby. The Faceless hold the village.

records.name: Odeck
records.summary: A Pailune village of the Odeck Tribe, with its own faction questline.
records.body: Odeck is a Pailune village held by the Odeck Tribe. A faction list places the tribe among Pailune's named peoples. The village has its own faction questline.

sources.title: The Hidden Gaming Lair: Crimson Desert map (fast-travel point)

records.name: Pororin
records.summary: A hidden shai and Fadus village inside Pororin Forest, watched by the forest's guardians.
records.body: Pororin is a hidden village of shais and Fadus inside [[region:pororin-forest]]. The Pororin Forest Guardians hold it. Travellers find it only after entering the forest tract itself.

sources.title: The Hidden Gaming Lair: Crimson Desert map (fast-travel point)

records.name: Senia
records.summary: A southern Hernand village on the location indexes, west of the Florindale and Pororin cluster.
records.body: Senia is a village in southern Hernand, listed on the Fextralife Locations page. No source read here names a ruling house or services. It sits west of the Florindale–Pororin cluster.

sources.title: The Hidden Gaming Lair: Crimson Desert map (fast-travel point)

records.name: Skoghorn
records.summary: A western Pailune mountain village of the Skoghorn Tribe, isolated and built around cold-country work.
records.body: The Skoghorn Tribe keeps this western Pailune village through farming that survives the cold, plus ranching and fishing. A single source adds that they honour a mountain spirit of the snowy highlands. The rest point is the village itself, not a separate territory.

records.name: Tariv
records.summary: A Demeniss village of the Tariv Sorcerers, sitting near the Crimson Desert border.
records.body: Tariv is filed under Demeniss because the faction list places the Tariv Sorcerers there. The village itself sits near the Crimson Desert border, in the same map cluster as Caledora and Burhum. Players find a desert-edge settlement rather than a court town.

sources.title: The Hidden Gaming Lair: Crimson Desert map (fast-travel point)

records.name: Thoron Town Hall Ruins
records.summary: Ruined town hall nearest Arcosa; no guide names it, so the region is inferred from that neighbour.
records.body: Thoron Town Hall Ruins is a fast-travel ruin nearest [[place:arcosa]]. No guide names the place yet; the region is inferred from that neighbouring settlement, though the point could also sit in Delesyia. What remains is a ruined hall, not a living town.

sources.title: The Hidden Gaming Lair: Crimson Desert map (fast-travel point)

records.name: Tinkerton Dig Site
records.summary: A Delesyia dig site tied to Marni's Tinkerton residents, listed beside Timberton.
records.body: Tinkerton Dig Site is a Delesyia worksite. Region guides name Tinkerton alongside Timberton as places populated by [[character:marni]]'s residents; no further dig-site facts were found. Players find a rest point at the workings rather than a town.

sources.title: The Hidden Gaming Lair: Crimson Desert map (fast-travel point)

records.name: Totemfelt
records.summary: A Pailune village by map position; no guide names it yet.
records.body: Totemfelt is a fast-travel village in Pailune by map position, north of the settlement of [[place:pailune]]. No guide names the place yet; the region is inferred from that nearby hub. Treat it as an unnamed-in-guides mountain village until a source appears.

sources.title: The Hidden Gaming Lair: Crimson Desert map (fast-travel point)

records.name: Vellua
records.summary: A southern Hernand fishing village with its own church, held by the Vellua Fishermen's Guild.
records.body: Vellua is a southern fishing village in Hernand. The Vellua Fishermen's Guild holds it, and the Fextralife location list also names a Church of Vellua. It sits on the southern shore of the same cluster as Florindale and Senia.
